items.prompt: 'We need structural change.' → ___ we need is structural change.
items.hintAfterError: Cleft sentence com a ideia de 'o que' no início.

items.prompt: 'Early adopters gain the advantage.' → It is the early adopters ___ gain the advantage.
'The lack of time limits learning.' → What limits learning ___ the lack of time.
'Managers block learning most often.' → ___ the managers who block learning most often.
items.hintAfterError: Em inglês a estrutura começa com sujeito vazio + be, sempre no singular, mesmo com 'managers'.

items.prompt: 'Career protection makes reskilling work.' → What ___ reskilling work is career protection.
